limitations_and_follow_up.detail: All five final assessments are insufficient_evidence, with differentiated issuer/ETF evidence and gaps. This does not prove useful decision discrimination. Broader primary-source extraction and appropriately labeled valuation scenarios need M4 scrutiny; no forced favorable conclusion was substituted.

The live report has both issuer-specific blockers and a broad policy-mapping gap. The separate cooperative fixture explicitly proves an optional source failure does not automatically block every instrument; the live report alone cannot establish that counterfactual.

Exact bear/base/bull and calculation chaining are regression-tested. A real scenario_price invocation is retained in incomplete m2-live-v4; accepted v7 did not produce numerical company valuation scenarios. Do not present it as a successful valuation recommendation.

Structured JSON contains exact completed-close thresholds, share basis and expiration, while Markdown currently renders condition descriptions and the source numerical tables separately. M3 presentation should show all condition fields together. Shared facts are repeated under multiple symbols, and the standalone FOMC factual claim is present in JSON but not its own Markdown row.
One successful run after six retained incomplete development candidates establishes bounded engineering acceptance, not repeatable production reliability or superiority to simpler systems.

FRED CSV timeouts, BIS HTTP failure, stale QQQ holdings and bounded filing excerpts remain recorded. SEC durations and debt concepts are not silently annualized or treated as interchangeable. No publication refresh occurred.
